smartReturn.title: Smart Return
smartReturn.description: Remind yourself when to leave so parking near your saved home can free up for neighbors.
smartReturn.setupDescription: Smart Return checks for parking near home so a spot is waiting when you get back.

benefits.check: One automatic parking check before you head home.
benefits.headsUp: A heads-up only when a spot opens near your home area.
benefits.private: Private by design — no live location tracking.

smartReturn.privacyBody: Your saved home area is stored only after you opt in. It powers Smart Return checks, is never shown to other people, never goes into analytics, and your live location is never tracked.
